title: Cargo Hollow
shortDescription: A hollow of stolen crates under the bank.
longDescription: The bank hollows out here into a hold of crates. One is biscuits. One is twine. None of them were offered. North is the skiff-line. West is the camp. East is the black mooring.

fixtures.name: Biscuit Crate
fixtures.lookDescription: A crate stamped for the refectory. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The crate is Collegium pine, lid pried, biscuits gone, crumbs left as if crumbs were a tip. Nett carried this. He says so. The tin that belonged on top is a reward, not a clue you have to guess.
